info.title: GetYourGuide API
info.description:
Tour & activity listings from GetYourGuide — prices, ratings, availability dates and destinations, plus per-activity detail and bulk sitemap discovery.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost. A query param an operation does not take is ignored and named in the `x-maviapi-unknown-params` response header; send the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header to have such a request refused with a free `400 unknown_param` instead.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/getyourguide

get.description:
Every tour & activity GetYourGuide lists for a place, across all of the site's pages: price, rating, review count, duration, next availability, image. `total` is the site's own count; rows come in the site's popularity order, then the remaining activities by ascending price.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: GetYourGuide place slug in the {city}-l{id} form, e.g. venice-l35 (from /locations, /catalog or an activity URL).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in one page, 1 to 1000 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the window starts again.

x-maviapi-unknown-params.description: Query params this endpoint does not take, comma separated; they were ignored. Send `x-maviapi-strict: 1` to get a free `400 unknown_param` instead.

Age.description: Seconds since the data was read from the site, as the body's `age`.

x-maviapi-fetched-at.description: When the data was read from the site (ISO 8601, UTC), as the body's `fetched_at`.

title.example: Venice: Marco Polo Airport Water Taxi Transfer

abstract.example: Make your arrival in Venice unforgettable with a water taxi transfer to your hotel or the nearest accessible point from Venice Airport. Enjoy a scenic ride and get a stunning first look at Venice.

get.description:
Full detail for one activity (as /activity: title, description, images, price, rating, reviews) plus where and how it happens: meeting point with address and coordinates, other start points and a separate end point, pickup, the main attraction (id, name, coordinates, URL) and the places visited with coordinates, the city (id, name, slug) and country, duration with its lower and upper bound in minutes, guide languages and the kind of guide offering them, category and the site's numeric category ids, free cancellation and the cancellation policy, and the activity URL.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.description: numeric activity id, the number after -t in an activity URL (e.g. 631866).

get.description:
One page (24 rows) of GetYourGuide's tour & activity search, by free text and/or place, with the site's filters and sort orders. `total` is the site's own count of results for the query; `has_more` says whether page+1 holds more.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: free text as typed in the site's search box (an activity, attraction or place). Give q, location or both; with neither, the example search for 'gondola' runs.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: limit to one place: a place slug from /locations (venice-l35) or its numeric id (35).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: only activities available on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD); alone, it searches that one day.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: last day of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD); needs date_from.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: lowest starting price, in EUR.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: highest starting price, in EUR.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popularity, price_asc, price_desc or rating_desc; with q the text match is weighed in too.

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: guide/audio languages, comma separated ISO codes (en, de, fr, es, it, ...): activities offered in any of them.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: durations, comma separated: 0-3h, 3-5h, 5-7h, full-day, 2-days, 3-days, 4-days, 5-days-plus.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: minimum average rating: 3.0, 3.5, 4.0 or 4.5.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: start times, comma separated: morning (before 12 PM), afternoon (12-5 PM), evening (after 5 PM).

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: comma separated: private, small-group, skip-the-line, wheelchair-accessible, hotel-pickup, originals.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: category ids, comma separated: the tc<n> in a category page address (gondola-tours-tc264 -> tc-264 or 264). With several, the rows of each category are merged and total is the sum of their counts.

parameters.name: departs_from
parameters.description: departure places, comma separated place slugs or ids from /locations.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page of the site's results, 24 per page (1 to 34; the site serves no pages past about 34). Narrow the query with filters to reach more rows.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in one page, 1 to 200 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the window starts again.

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Row fields to keep in a list answer, comma separated (at most 50). A dot reaches into an object, or into each object of an array (venue.city). A name no row has is a 400 that lists the fields a row has.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor of the previous page, sent with the same other params: the next page of the same stored copy of the list, so a walk never skips or repeats a row when the cache refreshes or the site reorders. A cursor for other params is 400 invalid_cursor; a copy that is gone is 410 cursor_expired (start again without cursor).

MaxAge.name: max_age
MaxAge.description: Serve a stored answer only when it was read at most this many seconds ago (0 to 86400); older, the site is read again. 0 is refresh=true. Any other value is 400 invalid_max_age.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later without any change. When true, wait the seconds in `Retry-After` (if sent) first.

FetchedAt.description: When this data was read from the site (ISO 8601, UTC). Also in the x-maviapi-fetched-at header.

Age.description: Seconds since fetched_at: 0 for a fresh read, more for a stored answer. Also in the Age header.

NextCursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same other params, for the next page of the same copy of the list; null on the last page.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used (`bad_request`), or, with the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header, a query param the operation does not take was sent (`unknown_param`, with the names in `params`).

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

example.message: Provide an API key via the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

CreditLimitReached.description: The plan's credits for this period are used up.

example.message: You've used all 1,000 credits in your Free plan for this period. Upgrade your plan for a higher allotment.

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key (`rate_limited`), or too many at once for its plan (`concurrency_limited`). Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key (600 requests a minute).

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched

CursorExpired.description: The stored copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.

example.message: The copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.
